AM31-01.title: Mesh hierarchy verification accepted fabricated boolean claims
AM31-01.resolution: Implemented verify_mesh_refinement_topology() checking element count ratio, node inheritance, edge midpoint provenance, centroid geometric containment, and h_max ratio. Supported independent_conforming with nestedness_proven=False; refused unknown methods.

AM31-02.title: Characteristic mesh size substituted area-average for frozen h_max
AM31-02.resolution: Restored Phase A frozen definition h_max = max_K diam(K). Characteristic h and refinement ratios strictly use h_max. Area-based size retained solely as auxiliary diagnostic characteristic_h_avg.

AM31-03.title: Quadrature failure mode substituted sensitivity difference for bound
AM31-03.resolution: Eliminated delta_22_26 fallback. Implemented strict fail-closed assess_quadrature_convergence() refusing evaluation when rho >= 1, sensitivities do not strictly decrease, or inputs are non-finite.

AM31-04.title: Self-referential test provenance (evidence preceded tested commit)
AM31-04.resolution: Enforced two-stage commit protocol. Stage A committed implementation (81cc8e2da7f7fdd70c063c7dafc84350c093046e); Stage B executed tests against Stage A and committed evidence.

AM31-05.title: Mathematical verification conflated QoI concordance with full BVP audit
AM31-05.resolution: Audited all 40 Tier 1 BVPs symbolically and numerically. Verified Navier-Cauchy equilibrium div(sigma) + f == 0, Hooke's law, Dirichlet boundary traces, and QoI quadrature concordance.

AM31-06.title: Mutable evidence dataclass allowed post-hoc falsification
AM31-06.resolution: Decorated MeshLevelEvidence with @dataclass(frozen=True). Verified FrozenInstanceError on attempted mutation.
